metadata.description: National statistics office earnings figures for COUNTRY_DATA.median_salary (research.py). One entry per country, each the office's latest published full-time earnings statistic in local currency, quoted from the office's own page. 'value' and 'unit' are as published; 'annual_equivalent' is the figure x12 / x52 where the office publishes monthly or weekly, used for magnitude checks only. A country with no entry has no sourced median and shows 'No local benchmark'.
